title: LureScope: Adversarial Fraud Triage and Portable Resilience Evidence
description:
LureScope safely triages RFC 5322 email, scores fraud-lure likelihood, applies adversarial attacks, and tests an input-normalization defense.

LureProof 0.2 expresses privacy-minimized fraud-control evidence as a strict in-toto Statement, optionally authenticated in a standard DSSE envelope with ECDSA P-256. Its default salted commitment prevents direct subject-hash matching between separately generated proofs, while preserving detector, threshold, model-artifact, attack, and defense provenance without message content.

LureScope reuses LureBench's detectors and attacks directly and publishes reproducible corpus-level robustness scorecards.
